title: Presentation call: Mr. John Smith, back pain (Dupixent, asthma)

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Hello, my name is Alex. I'm a pharmacist calling for Mr. John Smith.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Yes, this is John Smith. Where are you calling from?

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Yes, I'm Alex, a pharmacist here at the Lemon Specialty Pharmacy, and just to let you know, we are on a recorded line.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Oh yes, how can I help you?

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: I was just calling to check in to see how you were doing, but first, could you please verify your date of birth?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Oh yes, that is October 27th, 1954.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Thank you for that. I wanted to see how you were doing on the Dupixent that you get from us. It's 300 mg under the skin every other week for your asthma. Have you had any trouble using the medication or injecting it?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Oh no, it's been just fine. No trouble at all.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: And have you had any changes to your medication list? Have you started or stopped any medications?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: I did recently start taking a multivitamin.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Okay, I will update that. And have you missed any doses since starting the medication?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Oh no, I take it as prescribed.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Have you experienced any side effects?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Just some back pain.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Sorry to hear about that. That is a common side effect with this medication. You can try over the counter Aleve or Tylenol to help.

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Thank you, I will try that.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Have you been to the ER or the hospital recently?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: Oh no, I have not been, thank goodness.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Good to hear. And do you have any questions for me about the medication?

lines.speaker: patient
lines.text: No, none at all. Thank you.

lines.speaker: pharmacist
lines.text: Wonderful. Make sure you keep your doctor updated on how you are doing. Have a good day, Mr. Smith. Bye.
